title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces
tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

got.question: Which man should receive portrait-man.jpg: the short-haired man on the left or the bearded man in the centre?
Which person should receive portrait-woman.jpg: the blonde woman on the right, seen from behind, or the partially visible dark-haired person at the far-right back?

faults.what: Neither visible male coworker recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg; the requested male face replacement is absent in all supplied output frames.
The foreground woman's face does not recognizably match portrait-woman.jpg; the requested female face replacement is absent in all supplied output frames.

judge.summary: The output shows a 10-second office clip, but neither requested portrait identity is visibly applied.

must_haves.item: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as 10.1 seconds and the sampled frames show the office exchange throughout.

must_haves.item: The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: Neither male face resembles the supplied man's portrait, and the foreground woman's facial features do not match the supplied woman's portrait.

must_haves.item: The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
must_haves.why: The requested replacement identities are not established at all, although the visible coworkers remain distinct.

must_haves.item: Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show apparently unreplaced faces throughout rather than aligned portrait replacements.

must_haves.item: The original office, bodies, clothing, camera movement and shot timing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible office and clothing are consistent with the source frame, but a single source still cannot establish unchanged camera movement and shot timing.

must_haves.item: Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript confirms audible speech, but does not establish both original voices, synchronization, or the absence of added audio.
